convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED v4.11 prototype, per-state roots/steps/viewports from states.json, headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.62.1), deviceScaleFactor 2, animations/transitions frozen, fonts.google CDN blocked with Heebo/Noto Serif served from pencil/designs/fonts TTFs (the same files the .pen references) via fontconfig. Element capture uses an INTERIOR clip (ceil origin / floor size — the v001 exterior-sliver rule). input-edited adds a 2.4s settle so the Tab-scroll overlay thumb completes its 1.6s rest-fade (settled thumbs-hidden truth, v001-carried). LINUX DETERMINISM (new environment fact): browser targets are byte-deterministic only with Chromium flags --disable-font-subpixel-positioning --font-render-hinting=none --disable-lcd-text --force-color-profile=srgb --disable-partial-raster --disable-skia-runtime-opts --num-raster-threads=1 --disable-gpu — without the subpixel-positioning flag, glyph raster phase varies run-to-run (v001 captured on macOS and never hit this). Every state self-consistency-gated (three independent renders byte-identical, 18/18).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iter 1 — initial authoring from the normalized-prototype extraction (paint-ordered draw list from computed styles; per-line text via Range rects + a zero-size inline-block baseline probe; calibrated pen baseline model penY = baseline - offset(family,size); two-rect border model; under-rect radius model; nested wrap clip frame; z-layer sort with outline-above-static-below-sticky): 7/18 within budget, failures 1.1-2.1%. Iter 2 — per-(family,size) baseline offsets refined by in-distribution ink-delta medians measured export-vs-target (the loop's own compare as the instrument, v001 iter-3 technique: Heebo12 -0.5, Heebo13 +0.5, Heebo14 -1.0, Noto18/22 -0.5), plus focus rings re-modeled as single center-stroked rounded rects (Chromium rounds outlines to the element radius; pen rect stroke verified center-aligned): 17/18, only input-edited failing at 1.106% with every worst cell in the right-edge band. Iter 3 — the failing band was the overlay scroll thumb caught mid-fade in the TARGET (the contract's 300ms wait does not cover the 1.6s rest-fade after the Tab commit auto-scrolls the wrap); added the v001-documented 2.4s settle to target and extraction renders: 18/18 converged, worst 0.541%, best 0.044%. Residual is cross-rasterizer text AA. No voided rounds; all three honest.
